name: React

image.dockerfile:
FROM node:24-slim
WORKDIR /opt/eco
RUN npm init -y >/dev/null && npm install --no-audit --no-fund react@18.3.1 react-dom@18.3.1 vitest@2.1.9 jsdom@25.0.1 @testing-library/react@16.1.0 @testing-library/dom@10.4.0 @testing-library/user-event@14.5.2 @testing-library/jest-dom@6.6.3 && npm cache clean --force

conventions: React 18.3 function components in JavaScript with JSX (.jsx files, hooks, no class components), tested like real frontend work: vitest 2.1 + jsdom + Testing Library (render, screen, getByRole/getByLabelText, userEvent, waitFor; jest-dom matchers via `import "@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest"`). The code under test is a component module in starter/, solution/ and every bugs/<name>/ (e.g. Component.jsx, exporting the component by name). tests/vitest.config.mjs MUST be copied from the example (JSX automatic runtime + jsdom). Tests load the component with the vite-ignore dynamic import pattern: `const target = new URL(`../${process.env.TARGET ?? "starter"}/Component.jsx`, import.meta.url).href; const { Component } = await import(/* @vite-ignore */ target);`. Query the DOM the way a user sees it (roles, labels, visible text), never by class names or implementation details. Name `it` blocks after the behavior: `bugs[].expect` matches the failing test's name. No network: mock fetch with vi.fn when a component loads data. Read fixtures (e.g. tests/cases.json) with readFileSync(join(process.cwd(), "cases.json")): under jsdom import.meta.url is not a file: URL, and tests run with tests/ as the working directory.

areas.name: Effects and data loading (loading, error, cancel)
